Getting to know SVS

A college is somewhere you spend a part of your life

The course matters. So do the people you learn with and the place you come back to each day.

SVS Medical College has been part of Mahabubnagar since 1999. It grew from Sri Venkata Sai Educational Society, established in 1997, and sits alongside the group’s dental and nursing institutions.

If you’re getting to know us for the first time, start with the college you’re interested in. Then take a look around the campus.
